old_description: Schedule a chat with us today, and let's explore how renewable energy can power your future. Our team is ready to provide you with all the guidance you need to make informed decisions about sustainable energy solutions.
about:
Hawaii Solar Connection operates from Pāhoa on the island of Hawaii. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders. Its website presents a focus on helping residential customers navigate the transition to renewable energy.

The business functions as a retailer and service provider for solar power equipment. Its product catalog includes battery storage systems such as the Fortress Power Envy True 12k, eFlex Max 5.4 kWh, and eForce t models, covering a capacity range of 9.6 to 153 kWh. It also carries SimpliPhi 6.6 kWh and Discover 7.4 kWh batteries, along with Hyundai 410-watt bifacial solar modules. In addition to completed systems, the company lists mounting hardware among its product categories. Hawaii Solar Connection offers complimentary consultations, inviting prospective customers to schedule a chat to explore how renewable energy can power their future.

The company's messaging is directed at homeowners, emphasizing an easy and informative process for exploring green energy options. No specific commercial, industrial, or utility-scale customer segments are mentioned on its website.

Hawaii Solar Connection states that its team is ready to provide all the guidance needed to make informed decisions about sustainable energy solutions, positioning itself as an advisory resource rather than solely a hardware supplier.
